settings.heading: Two people, one sewing table, and a refusal to compromise on fabric
settings.body:
Velora began in a single room above a fabric wholesaler in Bengaluru, where our founder Anaïs Moreau and a pattern-cutter friend produced their first run of twelve silk dresses. The brief hasn't changed since: use real materials, cut with real tailoring, and sell fewer, better pieces rather than chasing every trend cycle.

Twelve years on, Velora works with a small number of European mills for wool and cashmere, and Indian ateliers for cutting, sewing and finishing.

settings.quote: We don't design for a season. We design pieces you'll still be reaching for in five years.
